caption: The drawing consists of a central rectangular panel set against a wider, light beige background. Within the panel, the background color is a muted taupe. At the top of the panel, there is a horizontal row of six evenly spaced black heart or spade shapes, each separated by small black dots. Below this, the main part of the composition features two leafy botanical forms: the one on the left is a tall, slender vertical stem with alternating black and white elongated leaves, and the one on the right is a more branched form, with smaller clusters of black and white leaves extending from its branches. Below these plant forms, there is another horizontal row of similar heart or spade shapes, separated by small black dots. Underneath this row is a narrow band consisting of a dashed line made up of alternating horizontal black and maroon segments. The bottom section of the panel contains a wide band filled with a wavy diagonal stripe pattern formed by alternating maroon and black curved stripes, set on a background of small black dots. The entire drawing uses a limited color palette of black, white, and maroon, set against taupe and beige backgrounds.
title: Wall Decoration Below Chair Rail
